SELECT
  'be-' || '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' || '-branch_expense-' || replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_','T') || 'Z' AS batch_id,
  '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
  CAST('${date-1d}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
  CAST(o.bill_no AS VARCHAR) AS bill_no,
  CAST(o.branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
  CAST(o.branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
  CAST(o.branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
  CAST(o.store_name AS VARCHAR) AS store_name,
  CAST(o.operate_branch_num AS INTEGER) AS operate_branch_num,
  CAST(o.operate_branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS operate_branch_name,
  CAST(o.expense_type AS VARCHAR) AS expense_type,
  CAST(o.direction AS VARCHAR) AS direction,
  CAST(o.amount AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS amount,
  CAST(o.due_amount AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS due_amount,
  CAST(o.paid_amount AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS paid_amount,
  CAST(o.payment_date AS VARCHAR) AS payment_date,
  CAST(o.tax_rate AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS tax_rate,
  CAST(o.tax_amount AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS tax_amount,
  CAST(o.audit_time AS VARCHAR) AS audit_time,
  CAST(o.create_time AS VARCHAR) AS create_time,
  CAST(o.reference_bill AS VARCHAR) AS reference_bill,
  CAST(o.memo AS VARCHAR) AS memo,
  CAST(o.settlement_state AS INTEGER) AS settlement_state,
  CAST(o.settlement_state_name AS VARCHAR) AS settlement_state_name,
  CAST(o.last_edit_time AS VARCHAR) AS last_edit_time
FROM input o
